claims.text: The system logged a thermal pressure state of 1 indicating elevated heat while memory pressure was normal; Safari's safe browsing update was scheduled to run after a delay of 1769 seconds and was ignored; an unrecognized attribute value in AddressBookSourceSync suggests a data format issue; the AirPort_Brcm43xx driver disabled wireless functionality; Thunderbolt power state transition completed rapidly; WebKit encountered an unexpected preroll completion notification; location services icon was set to inactive.
